The Celestial and Divine cannot inflow immediately into the natural mind... because in this mind reside the hereditary evils of the man... Hence the natural man, regarded in himself, loves only self and the world...
Goods and truths procreated are in the natural num... Thus the spiritual man is continually enriched by the elevation of truths and goods out of the natural man...
That power resides in the truths of the natural man, in proportion as he receives influx from the Lord through the spiritual man. Explained. AE 726:10.
To the natural mind of man there are two ways, one from Heaven, the other from the world... (Thus) the Lord does not inflow with Divine truth into the natural man except through the spiritual...
Every man is born natural, and also lives natural, until he becomes rational.

That the natural man is to be mastered, and is as it were to die with its concupiscences, and is to be subjected to the spiritual man, was represented by (the death in the wilderness of all who came out of Egypt).
That the natural man is not injured by these afflictions. Signified.

Besides, the natural man with everyone, so long as it is separated from the spiritual man... is Hell; because all the hereditary evil into which man is born is seated in his natural man, and is not removed thence except by the influx of Divine truth through Heaven; and this influx does not exist in the natural man except through the spiritual man; for the natural man is in the world, and the spiritual in Heaven; and therefore the spiritual man must first be opened before the Hell which is in the natural man can be removed...
In the same proportion the man becomes interiorly natural...
If he advances no further, he remains natural...
For the spiritual man is in Heaven, and the natural in the world...
Lamentation over those who become merely natural and sensuous. Signified, Explained.
Upon the earths, far beneath (the spiritual) dwell the natural; and, in the seas, the sensuous.
For man is born sensuous and natural; thus as it were in Hell...
Natural faith defined.
But all these things... although from the Word, before the spiritual mind has been opened, are natural; for they are only knowledge.
When the spiritual mind has been opened and formed, then the Lord forms the natural mind; for the natural mind is formed by the Lord through the spiritual mind. Explained.

Before faith becomes charity in form, it is natural; and what is natural can produce only what is natural... With these the natural mind only has been opened; but more deeply and interiorly according to the quality of the faith and the derivative quality of the life... AE 798:5. Explained.
To do good from obedience, being from the love of reward, is natural.
It is said reasonings from the natural man, because the natural man is in the delights of the love of self and the world...
For the Natural cannot enter into the Spiritual...
The life of truth separated from good is life merely natural...
That when men lead a natural life, or a life of the world, evils from Hell secretly... insinuate... falsities into them. Signified.
When the Church is in faith separated from charity, it is natural; and a Church merely natural is no Church; for the merely natural man looks solely to self and the world...

All the Natural is the general receptacle of spiritual things... For the Natural has been formed from the Spiritual as an effect from its effecting cause; and as, thus, a thousand things, which are spiritual, effect and form one natural thing, therefore this one thing... is the General.
There are two Internals with man... the Internal which is below... (and) from which he thinks while he lives in the world, is natural...
The spiritual Internal is opened... in proportion as the natural Internal is purified from the Hell which is there...
Transfers (the light from Heaven) into the Natural purified from evils...
He who believes that man has a Rational and an understanding before his Natural has been purified from evils, is mistaken...

As a civil man, as a moral man, and as a natural man... To live according to them as a natural man, is for the sake of what is human, and in order to shun the ill-repute that he is not of sound mind...
ISIan is an image of the world as to his natural mind... The natural mind is full of evils of every kind. Enumerated.
For with those who are merely natural there is not marriage from a spiritual origin... but from a natural origin...
So long as hatred has not been removed, the man is merely natural; and a merely natural man remains hereditarily in all evil...

Man has a spiritual mind, a rational mind, a natural mind, and a sensuous mind... By his natural mind he is in the world, and is a world, in the least form... The sensuous mind is first opened; afterwards the natural mind...
Finally, the natural mind is closed, even to the sensuous mind...
Thus the Spiritual and the Natural act as a one by correspondences...
All good conjoined with truth in the natural man. Signified, Explained.
The Natural of man is a trine: rational, natural, and sensuous... The Natural is middle (and) is either rational or sensuous...
The Spiritual and the Natural are united in each and all things of the world, as is the soul in each and all things of the body... Explained.
Knowledge is of wisdom, and affection is of love, in the degree which is called natural.
That there are two general forms, spiritual and natural... natural such as is that of plants. Explained.
After death he calls all the things which he sees in the Spiritual World natural, because they are similar; nevertheless... they are not natural, but are appearances of natural things...
The heat and light in the world are not material, but natural, and inflow into matters...
When seen in a natural state they do not appear so beautiful.
Concerning the difference in general between the Natural, the Spiritual, and the Celestial. General article.
When I returned into the natural state...
I was then in an interior natural state...
Hence a natural [man] comprehends nothing from spiritual writing; nor a spiritual [man] from natural...
That there is such a difference between the Natural, the Spiritual, and the Celestial, no Angel knows; because he cannot pass from a spiritual state into a natural one...
The Natural is gross and impure, (and therefore cannot enter the Spiritual).
Regarded in itself, the Natural is nothing but an external form, which is called the effect of spiritual things... and therefore all the Natural is from the Spiritual.
4. Natural things are all things which are of man's body. As these have come forth from (spiritual things) they perpetually come forth [from them]... They are correspondences...
5. That then man from natural becomes spiritual. (Explained.)
The natural man differs from the spiritual... so greatly that they cannot exist together. Explained.
5. The first of an animal and a vegetable is natural...
These are interior natural; the former... are exterior natural.
The essence of the light and heat from our sun is natural... The Natural can derive its essence from no other source than pure fire and pure light.
4. There is not any ratio between the Natural and the Spiritual; but there is conjunction by correspondences.
On the merely natural man; the quality of his mind. General article.

I heard an utterly natural man saying that he could rationally see many things equally as well as the Angels... The successive states of the minds of the merely natural represented in the changes of a Satan's face. Described, Explained.
God 4. 10. As the Natural originates from the Spiritual... they are everywhere together; and thus the Spiritual exercises its activities and operates its functions through the Natural.
The natural man separated from the spiritual. Described.
So that spiritual and natural things inflow conjoinedly...
The Lord could not have done this unless the natural man himself with Him also had been made Divine.
